title: CROWNEST THE YEAR
GOD'S DAILY PROVISION
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: golden sunlit valley with lush wheat field
sunlit mountain pass with golden light
peaceful river flowing through golden meadow
sunlit sanctuary stone table morning light
golden sunlit mountain valley autumn harvest
peaceful river winding through sunlit hills
golden light beaming over tranquil valley

scenes.a: If you are staring at an unpaid bill tonight, commit your financial needs to God.
Scripture promises, Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
Heavenly Father, we thank You that Your sovereign abundance overflows into every dry season of our lives.
You see our hard labor, our silent worries, and every practical requirement before us right now.
Open doors of daily provision and let Your divine goodness crown our work with true fruitfulness.
Establish the labor of our hands as we yield our decisions and trust in Your unfailing care.
In Jesus' name, Amen. Subscribe to walk in God's daily provision.
